_doc: Realized rating actions + spread events for 65 hospital systems from 2023-01-01 through 2025-Q1. Used for concurrent backtest validation of our composite credit score.
_sources: Moody's MIS rating-change publications, S&P Global Ratings press releases, Fitch rating actions, MSRB EMMA Material Event Notices, public bond-market commentary
_methodology: For each obligor, identify the most material credit event 2023-2025. Outcome categories: UPGRADE, AFFIRM_POSITIVE_OUTLOOK, AFFIRM_STABLE, AFFIRM_NEGATIVE_OUTLOOK, DOWNGRADE, MULTI_DOWNGRADE, DEFAULT.

Memorial Sloan Kettering.events: Moody's Aa3 stable 2024; strong cancer franchise

Johns Hopkins Health System.events: Moody's outlook revised to negative late 2024 — labor cost pressures

Mass General Brigham.events: S&P outlook to negative Feb 2024 on operating losses

Atrium Health.events: Affirmed AA stable through Advocate Health merger

Kaiser Foundation.events: Outlook revised to negative late 2024 — operating losses

Banner Health.events: Affirmed A+ stable; strong AZ market

Sutter Health.events: Outlook revised negative; labor + payer mix challenges

Wellstar Health System.events: Outlook to positive on GA growth + improved metrics
